archetype: Archetype 7: Electric & Neon (with a Premium Apple x Esports twist)

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-tight

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Bento box grids for data, overlapping asymmetric elements for marketing.

surface_strategies.navbar: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0B0B0F]/70 border-b border-white/10 sticky top-0 z-50
surface_strategies.cards_default: bg-[#12121A] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:border-[#00F0FF]/50 transition-all duration-300
surface_strategies.cards_premium: bg-[#12121A] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-8 relative overflow-hidden group hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(138,43,226,0.3)] transition-all duration-500
surface_strategies.buttons_primary: bg-[#00F0FF] text-[#0B0B0F] font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-full hover:bg-white transition-colors duration-300 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]
surface_strategies.buttons_secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-full hover:border-[#00F0FF] hover:text-[#00F0FF] transition-colors duration-300

components.hero: Bold typography centered or left-aligned with a dark gradient overlay. Use the esports tournament image with 40% opacity behind.
components.brand_marquee: Text-based typographical logos for Samsung, iQOO, Realme, AMD, Flipkart, Mars Cosmetics, Mirai, Alta. Use Manrope font, text-[#A0A0A0], uppercase, tracking-widest, slow scrolling.
components.creator_cards: Bento grid mode. Image-heavy cards using 'glassmorphism' overlay for subscriber/engagement stats at the bottom of the card.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI with dark customization. Inputs: bg-[#12121A] border-white/10 focus:border-[#00F0FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F0FF].
components.whatsapp_float: Fixed bottom-right corner. Glowing neon green or cyan circular button with Lucide MessageCircle icon.

animations.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
animations.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and glow (drop-shadow) for interactive cards.
animations.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items and list elements.

hero_background.description: Electrifying atmosphere at Intel Extreme Masters Katowice 2022 esports event.

gaming_setup_dark.description: Modern gaming station with an LED-lit keyboard and high-resolution monitor in a dark room.

esports_creator_1.description: Young man focused on playing a game.

esports_creator_2.description: Man looking down at his phone/device.

esports_creator_3.description: Young man wearing a red and black esports jersey.

neon_headphones.description: Gaming headphones with illuminated design on stand.

team_collaboration.description: A group of gamers participating in an eSports tournament indoors.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React for all standard UI icons (arrows, social links, stats, Whatsapp).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the 6 requested pages: Home, About, Services, Creators, Brands, Contact.
Use React, Tailwind CSS, and customize Shadcn components to fit the dark neon theme.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing-heavy layouts (like the Hero and Bento grids) to avoid Shadcn rigidity.
Implement the 'Apple x Esports' vibe by ensuring extremely high contrast, generous padding, and sleek glassmorphic surfaces.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all buttons, form inputs, and key sections.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided media URLs or build typographical elements (for logos).
Add a fixed Floating WhatsApp button on all pages.
Setup MongoDB connection for form submissions on the Contact and Creators onboarding pages.
